title: AARO appointed to head a space tiger team on UAP in space

tellings.quote:
Arrow was um appointed to head some sort
of a space tiger restudy team to examine
UAPs in space of some kind or another.

plain: An unnamed researcher, speaking on a podcast, says that AARO, the Pentagon's current office for investigating unexplained objects, was put in charge of a special task team, a so-called tiger team, to study such objects in space around 2024 or 2025. If so, it would mean the government is now formally looking beyond the skies to space itself.
